test_title: PYST 55: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All boxes are cube.

All cubes are squares.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boxes are squares.

II. Some squares are not cube.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/639de5a35b6f4bd1716a61eaf346661a0b496309ea3573fdae1a86b1e299565b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some boxes are squares → True (As All boxes are cube and All cubes are squares so, Some boxes are squares is true)

II. Some squares are not cube → False (It is indefinite, it may or may not be true, Hence, it is considered to be wrong conclusion)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
